description: Fresh chats for the rest of #152, written 2026-11-15 before any change and before any example message was added for them, in wording not used elsewhere: a body part sore from use (with a real injury as control), a finger or wrist hurt in a fall that gets no card, a small cut mentioned as an aside, other trail users (bikes, runners, mules; a real bear as control), how long wet wood takes to dry, and a missed turnoff (with a lost hiker and a junction passed on purpose as controls). Committed before the first run. Not to be tuned against.
grading: As holdout-chats-8.json: a chat passes only if every turn passes. card is the field card that fits ("none": no card fits; "-": not judged); a different card shown word for word fails the turn.

turns.q: my shoulders ache where the pack straps sit
calves are tight and sore after all that climbing yesterday
my lower back is stiff from sleeping on the ground
feet are throbbing after 15 miles today
i stepped in a hole and my ankle is swelling up and hurts to stand
turns.card: Twisted or sprained ankle, or a strained muscle

turns.q: he fell off the ledge onto his back and his neck hurts, he can't feel his fingers
jammed my finger catching a fall on the rocks and now its fat and bluish
she landed on her hand on the slab, the wrist is swollen and going purple
totally different thing but i nicked my thumb with my knife cutting cheese
he's fine now. also i cut my palm on a tin lid, it's bleeding a little
the hatchet slipped and there's a deep gash in his shin, blood is pouring out
mountain bikers are flying down the trail toward us, what do we do
a pack of trail runners is coming up behind me on a narrow bit
a string of pack mules is coming the other way, should i move
we just came around a bend and there's a big bear maybe 30 yards up from us
turns.card: A bear close by, charging or attacking

turns.q: how long do i have to leave damp sticks by the flames before they'll catch
i think we walked past our turnoff a couple miles ago
we never saw the sign for our trail and that was an hour back
i have no idea where i am and the trail is gone
turns.card: Lost: should I stay or keep moving?

turns.q: we passed the junction on purpose to see the lake, heading back now
